data.one_liner: A UI kit for implementing glassmorphism effects in Flutter applications.
data.what_it_does: Provides prebuilt widgets with glassmorphic effects, such as containers, buttons, cards, dialogs, bottom sheets, navigation bars, and text fields. It supports adjustable blur intensity, transparency, border radius, and gradient overlays.
use_when: You want to build an app with a modern frosted glass or glassmorphism design style.
You need prebuilt navigation bars, drawers, buttons, and dialogs styled with blur and gradient effects.
avoid_when: Your design system follows standard Material or Cupertino guidelines without glass effects.
You are concerned about heavy blur rendering performance on low-end devices.
strengths: Includes a wide variety of prebuilt glass widgets like containers, buttons, cards, and navigation components.
Supports customizable blur, opacity, border radius, and gradient overlays.
weaknesses: Heavy usage of blur and transparency can impact rendering performance on lower-end devices.
Design is strictly tied to the glassmorphic visual style.

alternatives.name: material_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick if you prefer standard Material Design components instead of glassmorphic UI.

alternatives.name: cupertino_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick if you prefer standard iOS Cupertino style instead of glassmorphism.

data.minimal_example:
GlassContainer(
  width: 300,
  height: 200,
  blur: 20,
  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(15),
  gradient: LinearGradient(
    begin: Alignment.topLeft,
    end: Alignment.bottomRight,
    colors: [
      Colors.white.withAlpha(51),
      Colors.white.withAlpha(26),
    ],
  ),
  child: Center(child: Text("Glassmorphic Container")),
)
